# Fired defect vocabulary

A pinhole is a small opening in a fired coating. A blister is a raised closed feature. A chip removes part of an edge. Silver bloom names an unintended adherent silver appearance on a clear production face.

These are descriptive terms, not acceptance grades. Use the [surface rubric](surface-rubric.md) for classification boundaries. A reference photograph may illustrate vocabulary without establishing permissible size or count.
